subject: Agriculture
title: The Future of Animal Farming
description: One-minute skill: The Future of Animal Farming.

hook.text: By 2050, the world will need 50% more animal protein—unless we change what we eat and how we farm.

buildup.text: Rising incomes in Asia and Africa are driving meat demand upward. People eat more meat as they get richer.

discovery.text: Plant-based proteins, cultured meat, and precision fermentation could supply protein without expanding herds.

twist.text: Livestock provide 1.3 billion livelihoods globally. Replacing animals displaces people, not just systems.

climax.text: The future probably isn't all-animal or no-animal—it's fewer animals, raised better, alongside new proteins.

punchline.text: The question isn't meat or no meat. It's how much and how.

quiz.question: How many livelihoods depend on livestock globally?
